run_grammar_constrained_generation: run grammar-constrained text generation with GPT-2 using an EBNF grammar file and custom prefixes
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar string with a root symbol and tokenizer
build_grammar_logits_processor: build a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor from an IncrementalGrammarConstraint to enforce grammar rules during generation
generate_with_logits_processor: generate text using model.generate with a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to produce grammar-valid output
load_gpt2_model_and_tokenizer: load a pretrained GPT-2 model and tokenizer for grammar-constrained causal language generation
